# ===== LEAD SYNTH =====
t_lead = np.arange(int(sample_rate * duration_lead)) / sample_rate
# Sawtooth wave at ~220Hz for bright synth sound
freq_lead = 220
lead_phase = 2 * np.pi * freq_lead * t_lead
lead = 2 * (lead_phase / (2 * np.pi) - np.floor(lead_phase / (2 * np.pi) + 0.5))

lead = lead * 0.7 + 0.2 * np.sin(2 * lead_phase) + 0.1 * np.sin(3 * lead_phase)

## Overview
An original high-energy keygen tune composed in FastTracker II with custom synthesized instruments. The tune features a driving rhythm, catchy melodies, and clean looping structure typical of classic keygen music.

- Pattern: Strong on beats 1 & 3 (verses), double-time on chorus
